pairs: Et vidi quod aperuisset Agnus unum de septem sigillis,
And I saw that the Lamb had opened one of the seven seals.
et audivi unum de quatuor animalibus,
And I heard one of the four living creatures saying,
et qui sedebat super illum, habebat arcum,
And he who was sitting upon it was holding a bow,
and a crown was given to him,
and he went forth conquering, so that he might prevail.
And when he had opened the second seal,
I heard the second living creature saying:
datum est ei ut sumeret pacem de terra,
And it was granted to him who was sitting upon it that he would take peace from the earth,
and that they would kill one another.
et datus est ei gladius magnus.
And a great sword was given to him.
And when he had opened the third seal,
I heard the third living creature saying:
et qui sedebat super illum, habebat stateram in manu sua.
And he who was sitting upon it was holding a balance in his hand.
Et audivi tamquam vocem in medio quatuor animalium dicentium:
And I heard something like a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying,
Bilibris tritici denario et tres bilibres hordei denario,
“A double measure of wheat for a denarius,
and three double measures of barley for a denarius,
but do no harm to wine and oil.”
And when he had opened the fourth seal,
I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying:
And he who was sitting upon it,
et data est illi potestas super quatuor partes terræ,
And authority was given to him over the four parts of the earth,
and by the creatures of the earth.
And when he had opened the fifth seal,
vidi subtus altare animas interfectorum propter verbum Dei,
the souls of those who had been slain because of the Word of God and because of the testimony that they held.
And they were crying out with a loud voice,
et non vindicas sanguinem nostrum de iis qui habitant in terra?
will you not judge and not vindicate our blood against those who dwell upon the earth?”
Et datæ sunt illis singulæ stolæ albæ:
And white robes were given to each of them.
et dictum est illis ut requiescerent adhuc tempus modicum donec compleantur conservi eorum,
And they were told that they should rest for a brief time,
until their fellow servants and their brothers,
who were to be slain even as they were slain,
Et vidi cum aperuisset sigillum sextum:
And when he had opened the sixth seal, I saw,
et ecce terræmotus magnus factus est,
and behold, a great earthquake occurred.
et sol factus est niger tamquam saccus cilicinus:
And the sun became black, like a haircloth sack,
et luna tota facta est sicut sanguis:
and the entire moon became like blood.
et stellæ de cælo ceciderunt super terram,
And the stars from heaven fell upon the earth,
sicut ficus emittit grossos suos cum a vento magno movetur:
just as when a fig tree, shaken by a great wind, drops its immature figs.
et cælum recessit sicut liber involutus:
And heaven receded, like a scroll being rolled up.
et insulæ de locis suis motæ sunt:
and the islands, were moved from their places.
And the kings of the earth,
et liber absconderunt se in speluncis,
hid themselves in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
And they said to the mountains
et abscondite nos a facie sedentis super thronum,
and hide us from the face of the One sitting upon the throne,
and from the wrath of the Lamb.
quoniam venit dies magnus iræ ipsorum:
For the great day of their wrath has arrived.
And who will be able to stand?”
